$comment: Drop-in template. Copy to <host-repo>/.vscode/tasks.json when pr-review-agent is cloned as a subfolder of your host repo, so Command Palette -> 'Tasks: Run Task' offers the pr-agent.* tasks. The repo's own .vscode/tasks.json assumes pr-review-agent IS the workspace root and does not work in that layout. VS Code tasks cannot discover the subfolder dynamically: if you cloned it under a different name than 'pr-review-agent', replace every '${workspaceFolder}/pr-review-agent' below with your actual path. PR_AGENT_CWD stays ${workspaceFolder} on purpose — that is the HOST repo being reviewed, where docs/pr-reviews/ is written. Requires the MCP server to be built first: cd pr-review-agent/mcp-server && npm install && npm run build

tasks.detail: Detect and review all open PRs
